confidence.note: Raised by the real CPC for 'linkedin post generator' (Keyword Planner) and churn data for web AI writing tools.

pricing_power.note: Free extensions and ChatGPT set the floor; Supergrow dropped its $19 tier; $15 entry plans exist.

build_effort.note: An LLM wrapper with voice samples: about 2-3 weeks at 10 h/week for a developer (estimate).

willingness_to_pay.note: Competitors charge $39-$99, but free tiers abound and AI apps churn 30% faster.

legal_regulatory.note: CCPA thresholds out of reach; FTC fake-review rule does not cover own ghostwritten posts.

platform_dependency.note: LinkedIn bans scraping extensions, gates posting API and down-ranks AI slop.

market_risk.note: AI-slop backlash: 1M+ slop-button clicks in 2 weeks could shrink the habit.

assets.note: No audience, list or network stated.

interest.note: Goal stated as side income; no stated passion for LinkedIn content.

tam.reasoning: Global AI writing assistant software, 2024; 360iResearch says $1.13B, so treat as a range.

sam.reasoning: No source splits out LinkedIn post writing in the US.

som.reasoning: 50 paying customers x $19 x 12 months = $11,400 (year 1, solo founder).

competitors_found.reasoning: Taplio, Supergrow, EasyGen, Kleo, ContentIn, Typegrow, AuthoredUp, Waalaxy (adjacent), Postiz; plus 5 dated PH launches.

demand_trend.reasoning: Likely-AI long posts 54% (Oct 2024) to 78% (Sep 2026); LinkedIn cuts AI-slop views 40%.

price.reasoning: The founder's stated price; matches AuthoredUp ($19.95) and the old Supergrow Starter.

variable_cost_per_unit.reasoning: LLM: 270k input x $0.25/M + 45k output x $2/M = $0.16; Stripe 2.9% + $0.30 = $0.85; Billing 0.7% = $0.13. Total $1.14.

churn_monthly_pct.reasoning: B2C SaaS 5.8%/month (Focus Digital) x 1.3 AI premium (RevenueCat) = 7.5%, rounded to 8% within a 6-10% range.

cac.reasoning: Non-branded Google CPC $12.48 / 1.3% = ~$950; LinkedIn Ads $11.12 / 1.3% = ~$850; range $267-$2,200.

payback_months.reasoning: $950 / $17.86 per month = 53 months, longer than the 12.5-month lifetime.

fixed_costs_month.reasoning: Supabase Pro $25 + domain ~$2; hosting on a free tier (Vercel limits unknown).

break_even_customers_per_month.reasoning: $27 / $17.86 = 1.5, rounded up to 2. Side-income goal of $1,000/month needs ~56 customers.

time_to_first_revenue_weeks.reasoning: 3 weeks to MVP at 10 h/week + 2 weeks of launch posts and trials.

launch_reason: The founder's chosen market, and the largest LinkedIn market.
cheapest_test: Pre-sell a $300/month done-for-you post package to 50 US consultants by LinkedIn DM in 7 days; 2 paid pilots or stop.
kill_criteria: Fewer than 2 paid pilots ($300) from 50 DMs by day 7: stop the service path.
Fewer than 10 replies to 50 DMs by day 5: change the segment before writing anything.
If the SaaS is built anyway: fewer than 5 paying users at $19 after 60 days: archive it.

rescue.change: Sell done-for-you voice-matched LinkedIn posts to US consultants at $300/month, using the tool internally, via 50 LinkedIn DMs a week.
rescue.why: Fixes ltv_cac and pricing_power: buyers already pay ghostwriters $500-$1,500/month, so one client covers a paid CAC.
rescue.requires: Editing and writing skill the founder has not shown; caps at about 4 clients at 10 h/week.

rescue.change: Sell a multi-client voice workspace to LinkedIn ghostwriters and small agencies at $79/month per writer.
rescue.why: Fixes pricing_power and differentiation: ghostwriters manage several voices, a job ChatGPT does poorly.
rescue.requires: Direct sales to a small, hard-to-reach niche; 20+ interviews first.

rescue.change: Niche for developers: turn GitHub commits, changelogs and blog posts into LinkedIn posts for dev advocates and engineering leads.
rescue.why: Uses the founder's developer edge for differentiation and a free channel (Show HN, dev communities).
rescue.requires: Proof that dev advocates will pay; $19 price still leaves LTV:CAC thin.

type_checks.note: B2C SaaS 5.8%/month; AI apps churn 30% higher, only 6.1% of monthly AI subs active after a year. Estimate 6-10%/month.
Lock-in is a stored voice profile and a schedule queue: a user can paste 10 old posts into ChatGPT and leave.
